cases.name: check_crew.py reads a crew's decision.mode as Orkeon 1.4.0 does at load (V-68): optional requires a without: relay naming an agent on every decision task and refuses a fallback and system_one_decide, a relay needs optional, none refuses a decision task, required is refused by D96, a bad mode is refused; a decision task needs no expectedOutput, and optional with its relays passes with no D96 error
cases.cmd:
python3 -c 'import yaml' 2>/dev/null || { printf 'ok (skipped: PyYAML is missing)'; exit 0; }
n=dmode-{{SID}}; t={{FIX}}/teams/$n; s={{FIX}}/settings/$n; c={{CLAUDE}}/skills/orkeon-crew/scripts/check_crew.py
mkdir -p "$t/crew/agents" "$t/crew/tasks" "$s" || exit 1
want() { printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -qF -- "$1" || { printf 'MISSING [%s] in:
%s' "$1" "$out"; exit 1; }; }
never() { printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -qF -- "$1" && { printf 'UNEXPECTED [%s] in:
%s' "$1" "$out"; exit 1; }; return 0; }
printf 'role: r
goal: g
allowDelegation: false
' > "$t/crew/agents/a.yaml"
printf 'description: d
expectedOutput: o
agent: a
when: { pick.route: [fix] }
' > "$t/crew/tasks/go.yaml"

goal: g
process: sequential
decision: { mode: Optional }

    route: { choice: { fix: a defect, doc: a question } }

' > "$t/crew/tasks/pick.yaml"
out=$(python3 "$c" "$t" 2>&1)
never "ERROR   crew/"; never "neither 'fallback'"

  questions:

out=$(python3 "$c" "$t" 2>&1)
want "ERROR   crew/tasks/pick.yaml decision: no without: relay, which a crew with decision.mode: optional requires"
want "ERROR   crew/tasks/pick.yaml decision: a fallback, which a crew with decision.mode: optional never uses"
never "'expectedOutput' is required"

  questions:
    route: { choice: { fix: a defect, doc: a question } }
  without: { agent: ghost }
' > "$t/crew/tasks/pick.yaml"

goal: g
allowDelegation: false
tools: [system_one_decide]

printf 'name: x
goal: g
process: sequential
' > "$t/crew/config.yaml"

out=$(python3 "$c" "$t" 2>&1)
want "ERROR   crew/tasks/pick.yaml decision: a without: relay, which Orkeon refuses at load unless the crew declares decision.mode: optional"
printf 'name: x
goal: g
process: sequential
decision: { mode: none }
' > "$t/crew/config.yaml"
printf 'description: d
decision:
  questions:
    route: { choice: { fix: a defect, doc: a question } }
  fallback: { route: fix }
' > "$t/crew/tasks/pick.yaml"
out=$(python3 "$c" "$t" 2>&1)

printf 'name: x
goal: g
process: sequential
decision: { mode: required }
' > "$t/crew/config.yaml"
out=$(python3 "$c" "$t" 2>&1)
want "ERROR   crew/config.yaml: decision.mode: required: without a decision provider"
printf 'name: x
goal: g
process: sequential

out=$(python3 "$c" "$t" 2>&1)

printf 'name: x
goal: g
process: sequential
decision: { mode: optional }
' > "$t/crew/config.yaml"
rm -f "$t/crew/tasks/go.yaml"; printf 'description: d
expectedOutput: o
agent: a
' > "$t/crew/tasks/pick.yaml"
out=$(python3 "$c" "$t" 2>&1)
want "decision.mode: optional declares at least one decision task, and this crew has none"
printf 'name: x
goal: g
process: sequential
' > "$t/crew/config.yaml"
printf 'role: r
goal: g
allowDelegation: false
tools: [system_one_decide]
' > "$t/crew/agents/a.yaml"

cases.name: check_crew.py reads the System One forms of an agent as Orkeon 1.4.0 does at load (V-68) — thinking effort in any case, auto, { auto: true, min, max } within the host's levels, enabled: auto, skills as a list or { auto: true, fallback }, compaction — refusing a bad shape, and refusing each auto form under decision.mode: none
cases.cmd:
python3 -c 'import yaml' 2>/dev/null || { printf 'ok (skipped: PyYAML is missing)'; exit 0; }
n=dauto-{{SID}}; t={{FIX}}/teams/$n; s={{FIX}}/settings/$n; c={{CLAUDE}}/skills/orkeon-crew/scripts/check_crew.py
mkdir -p "$t/crew/agents" "$t/crew/tasks" "$s" || exit 1
want() { printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -qF -- "$1" || { printf 'MISSING [%s] in:
%s' "$1" "$out"; exit 1; }; }
never() { printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -qF -- "$1" && { printf 'UNEXPECTED [%s] in:
%s' "$1" "$out"; exit 1; }; return 0; }
printf 'name: x
goal: g
process: sequential
' > "$t/crew/config.yaml"
printf 'role: r
goal: g
allowDelegation: false
llm: { thinking: { enabled: auto, effort: { auto: true, min: Low, max: high } } }
skills: { auto: true, fallback: [/workspace/skills/a.md] }
compaction: { triggerShare: 0.5, prune: true }
' > "$t/crew/agents/a.yaml"
printf 'description: d
expectedOutput: o
agent: a
llmOverride: { thinking: { effort: Auto } }
' > "$t/crew/tasks/t.yaml"

printf 'role: r
goal: g
allowDelegation: false
llm: { thinking: { enabled: maybe, effort: { min: high, max: low } } }
skills: { fallback: [/a.md] }
compaction: { triggerShare: 1.5, foo: 1 }
' > "$t/crew/agents/a.yaml"
printf 'role: r
goal: g
allowDelegation: false
llm: { thinking: { effort: { auto: true, min: xhigh } } }
skills: /a.md
' > "$t/crew/agents/b.yaml"
out=$(python3 "$c" "$t" 2>&1)
want "thinking.enabled: 'maybe' is not true, false or auto"
want "the map form is System One's pick and needs 'auto: true'"
want "min 'high' is above max 'low'"
want "skills: the map form is System One's pick and needs 'auto: true'"
want "compaction.triggerShare is '1.5'"
want "crew/agents/a.yaml compaction: 'foo' is not a key Orkeon reads"

goal: g

goal: g

skills: { auto: true }
compaction: { prune: true }

for w in 'thinking: { effort: auto }, which System One picks and a crew with decision.mode: none refuses' 'thinking: { enabled: auto }, which System One picks' 'skills: { auto: true }, which System One picks' 'compaction: { prune: true }, which the decision model judges' "crew/tasks/t.yaml llmOverride thinking: thinking: { effort: auto }"; do want "$w"; done

cases.name: check_crew.py reads profile: auto as Orkeon 1.4.0 does (V-68): it needs Orkeon:Decision:Route:Ladder of two profiles the settings define, no model beside it, and is refused under decision.mode: none; the settings may not name a profile auto, a ladder of one rung or an auto rung, nor Llm:Thinking:Effort auto
cases.cmd:
python3 -c 'import yaml' 2>/dev/null || { printf 'ok (skipped: PyYAML is missing)'; exit 0; }
n=dprofauto-{{SID}}; t={{FIX}}/teams/$n; s={{FIX}}/settings/$n; c={{CLAUDE}}/skills/orkeon-crew/scripts/check_crew.py
mkdir -p "$t/crew/agents" "$t/crew/tasks" "$s" || exit 1
want() { printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qF -- "$1" || { printf 'MISSING [%s] in:\n%s' "$1" "$out"; exit 1; }; }
never() { printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qF -- "$1" && { printf 'UNEXPECTED [%s] in:\n%s' "$1" "$out"; exit 1; }; return 0; }

printf 'description: d\nexpectedOutput: o\nagent: a\n' > "$t/crew/tasks/t.yaml"
printf '{"Llm": {"BaseUrl": "http://localhost:11434", "Model": "m", "Profiles": {"small": {"BaseUrl": "http://localhost:11434"}}}, "Orkeon": {"Decision": {"Route": {"Ladder": ["default", "small"]}}}}' > "$s/appsettings.json"

cases.name: check_team.py reads .decision({ mode }) as Orkeon 1.4.0 does at load (V-68): optional requires a without: relay and refuses a fallback, a relay needs optional, none refuses a decision task, required is refused by D96; llm.profile("auto") is refused on an agent
cases.cmd:
python3 -c 'import yaml' 2>/dev/null || { printf 'ok (skipped: PyYAML is missing)'; exit 0; }
n=tmode-{{SID}}; t={{FIX}}/teams/$n; c={{CLAUDE}}/skills/orkeon-crew/scripts/check_team.py
mkdir -p "$t/crew" || exit 1
want() { printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qF -- "$1" || { printf 'MISSING [%s] in:\n%s' "$1" "$out"; exit 1; }; }
never() { printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qF -- "$1" && { printf 'UNEXPECTED [%s] in:\n%s' "$1" "$out"; exit 1; }; return 0; }
ts() { printf 'const a = agentBuilder().name("a").role("R").goal("g").allowDelegation(false)%s.build();\nconst pick = taskBuilder().name("pick").description("d").decision(%s).build();\nconst fix = taskBuilder().name("fix").description("d").expectedOutput("o").agent(a).withContext(pick).when("pick", { route: ["fix"] }).build();\nglobalThis.crew = crewBuilder().name("fb").goal("g").process("sequential")%s.withAgents([a]).withTasks([pick, fix]).build();\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" > "$t/crew/crew.ork.ts"; }
Q='questions: { route: { choice: { fix: "a defect", doc: "a question" } } }'
ts '' "{ $Q, without: { agent: \"a\" } }" '.decision({ mode: "optional" })'; out=$(python3 "$c" "$t" 2>&1)
never "decision task 'pick'"
ts '' "{ $Q, fallback: { route: \"fix\" }, without: { agent: \"a\" } }" '.decision({ mode: "optional" })'; out=$(python3 "$c" "$t" 2>&1)
want "decision task 'pick' declares a fallback, which a crew with decision.mode: optional never uses"
ts '' "{ $Q, fallback: { route: \"fix\" } }" '.decision({ mode: "optional" })'; out=$(python3 "$c" "$t" 2>&1)
want "decision task 'pick' has no without: relay"
ts '' "{ $Q, without: { agent: \"a\" } }" ''; out=$(python3 "$c" "$t" 2>&1)
want "decision task 'pick' declares a without: relay, which Orkeon refuses at load unless"
ts '' "{ $Q, fallback: { route: \"fix\" } }" '.decision({ mode: "none" })'; out=$(python3 "$c" "$t" 2>&1)
want "decision task 'pick', which a crew with decision.mode: none refuses"
ts '' "{ $Q }" '.decision({ mode: "required" })'; out=$(python3 "$c" "$t" 2>&1)
want '.decision({ mode: "required" }): without a decision provider'
never "neither a 'fallback'"
ts '.llm(llm.profile("auto"))' "{ $Q, fallback: { route: \"fix\" } }" ''; out=$(python3 "$c" "$t" 2>&1)
want 'llm.profile("auto") names the LLM profile'
printf 'ok'
